title: Create Table [PRIMARY KEY]
description:
## PRIMARY KEY
A primary key is a column that uniquely identifies each row. No two rows can have the same primary key, and it can never be empty.
```sql
CREATE TABLE users (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT
);
```
If you try to insert two rows with the same id, SQL will throw an error. This keeps your data clean.

In SQLite, `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` also auto-increments - if you don't provide an id, it picks the next number automatically.
```sql
INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('Steve');
-- id is automatically 1
INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('Bob');
-- id is automatically 2
```
---
## Assignment:
BWS needs a table for tracking customer accounts. Create a table called `customers` with:
- `id` (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
- `name` (TEXT)
- `plan` (TEXT)

Then insert 3 customers WITHOUT specifying the id with the names Steve, Bob and Alice with plans free pro and enterprise.
starterCode: -- Create the table and insert 3 customers
runHarness: SELECT * FROM customers ORDER BY id ASC;
expectedOutput:
id | name | plan
1 | Steve | free
2 | Bob | pro
3 | Alice | enterprise
